column1: # CANDIDATE: proposed by the AI workflow; not reviewed; nothing accepted

column6: ADD-01/3.1 adds an obligation (ADD-01:3.1); the summary does not mention it: 'The attendance record is held by the Authority. A Bidder that considers its attendance to have been incorrectly recorded shall notify the Authority through the Portal within five (5) Working Days of this Addendum.'
ADD-01/AppA/para1 replaces VOL-IV:F4-A; the summary does not mention it: 'Form 4-A is reissued below to add the acknowledgement of Addenda at paragraph 1. Bidders shall use this version.'
ADD-02:7.2 states 'Failure to submit Form 4-G shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'adds Form 4-G'

'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6', but ADD-02/9.1 reinstates it in an amended form: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty-five per cent (35%) for the construction phase. Failure …' (as issued: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty per cent (30%) f…')
ADD-02:9.1 states 'Failure to submit the certificate shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6'

ADD-02/T1-1-rev/note(2) amends VOL-I:11.2; the summary does not mention it: '(2) The combined score weighting stated in Volume I Clause 11.2 is amended to sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial.'
ADD-02/5.2 adds an obligation (VOL-II:S3); the summary does not mention it: 'Bidders shall reflect the amended limit in the process design submitted under Volume II Section 3.'
ADD-02/9.2 ends the effect of ADD-01:4.2; the summary does not mention it: 'Section 4.2 of Addendum No. 1 ceases to have effect.'
'withdraws Form 4-G': no provision of ADD-03 does this
'adds a new Clause 11.6': no provision of ADD-03 does this
'responds to clarification requests 15 to 18', but ADD-03/Q17 adds an obligation (ADD-03:Q17): 'Bidders shall price the Project as amended by this Addendum.'

ADD-03/3.1(a) ends the effect of ADD-02:7.2; the summary does not mention it: 'Form 4-G (Cybersecurity Compliance Undertaking), added by Addendum No. 2 Section 7, is withdrawn. Bidders shall disregard it and shall not submit it. Section 7.2 of Addendum No. 2 ceases to have effect.'

ADD-03/5.1 amends VOL-I:6.4; the summary does not mention it: 'In Volume I Clause 6.4, ‘SAR 4,500,000 (four million five hundred thousand Saudi Riyals)’ is deleted and ‘SAR 5,600,000 (five million six hundred thousand Saudi Riyals)’ is substituted.'

ADD-03/5.2(a) amends VOL-I:6.3; the summary does not mention it: 'In Volume I Clause 6.3, ‘one hundred and eighty (180) days’ is deleted and ‘two hundred and ten (210) days’ is substituted. The Proposal validity period in Clause 7.1 is unchanged.'

ADD-03/5.2(b) confirms VOL-I:7.1; the summary does not mention it: 'In Volume I Clause 6.3, ‘one hundred and eighty (180) days’ is deleted and ‘two hundred and ten (210) days’ is substituted. The Proposal validity period in Clause 7.1 is unchanged.'

ADD-03/6.1 inserts new text after VOL-I:11.5; the summary does not mention it: 'A new Clause 11.6 is added to Volume I: ‘11.6 Where, on completion of the combined evaluation, two or more Proposals are within two per cent (2%) of one another, the Authority may apply such further criteria as it considers appropriate to …'
ADD-03:2.2 is unresolved (no op yet), so its effect cannot be compared with the summary
ADD-03:4.3 is unresolved (no op yet), so its effect cannot be compared with the summary
